warning.titlePre: Mercedes Sprinter 314-319 CDI Known Issues by Engine
paragraphs: If your Sprinter 314-319 CDI has the OM651 4-cylinder diesel, injector seal leaks and timing chain wear are well-documented on this engine - a pattern shared across the wider Mercedes commercial vehicle range. We replace injector seals, timing chain components and gaskets as standard on every OM651 rebuild.

If your Sprinter has the OM642 V6 diesel, swirl flap and injector wear are the established patterns on this engine. We replace swirl flaps, injector seals and gaskets as standard on every OM642 rebuild.
warning.source: Source: established commercial vehicle specialist pattern, per VRF-mercedes-sprinter.md. Both engine codes confirmed for the VS30 2018-2022 generation
